intro_home: Hey, I'm Cubr! Got a scrambled cube? I'll solve it with you, one turn at a time. Place your phone or laptop on a table, show your cube to the camera, and tap Start.
scan_intro: Let's scan your cube. Here's the rule: yellow on top, white on the bottom, and red facing the camera. That's your front.
scan_red: Hold the cube with red facing the camera and yellow on top. Keep it inside the box.
scan_green: Lovely. Now turn the cube so the green side faces the camera. Keep yellow on top.
scan_orange: Great. Keep turning the same way, and show me the orange side.
scan_blue: One more turn. Show me the blue side.
scan_yellow: Now the top. Turn red back to the front, then tip the yellow top towards the camera.
scan_white: Last one! Flip the cube so the white bottom faces the camera.
scan_center: Please place the cube in the centre of the box.
scan_closer: Bring the cube a little closer, so it fills the box.
already_red: I already have that side. Please show me the red side.
already_green: I already have that side. Please show me the green side.
already_orange: I already have that side. Please show me the orange side.
already_blue: I already have that side. Please show me the blue side.
already_yellow: I already have that side. Please show me the yellow top.
already_white: I already have that side. Please show me the white bottom.
scan_done: All six sides scanned! Let me check the colours.
review_ok: Got it! Your cube looks good. Check it matches, then tap Solve.
review_fix: A few stickers look a little off. Tap any wrong sticker to fix it.
review_demo: Demo time! Scramble a solved cube with these moves, or just watch. Tap Solve when you're ready.
review_manual: Paint each sticker to match your cube. Red in front, yellow on top.
choose: Pick your route. The learn route teaches you the beginner method, stage by stage. The fast route finishes in the fewest moves.
hold: Hold your cube with yellow on top and red facing you. Keep it that way the whole time, and I'll tell you when to turn the whole cube.
go: Let's go! Follow each move, and tap when you're done.
stage_cross: Stage one. The white cross. Make a white plus on the bottom, with each edge matching its side centre.
stage_corners: Stage two. White corners. Park a corner above its spot, then repeat the trigger move until it drops in.
stage_middle: Stage three. The middle layer. Match each edge with its centre, then insert it to the right, or to the left.
stage_ycross: Stage four. The yellow cross. One little algorithm turns the top into a yellow plus.
stage_yedges: Stage five. Yellow edges. Match the top edges with their side colours.
stage_ycorners: Stage six. Corner homes. Move each top corner to its home spot.
stage_twist: Final stage! Twist the corners until yellow faces up. The bottom will look messy for a moment. Trust it, it fixes itself at the end.
alg_cross: First, the white cross. Follow each move.
alg_sexy_1: Trigger move. R, U, R prime, U prime.
alg_sexy_2: Trigger move, two times. R, U, R prime, U prime.
alg_sexy_3: Trigger move, three times. R, U, R prime, U prime.
alg_sexy_4: Trigger move, four times. R, U, R prime, U prime.
alg_sexy_5: Trigger move, five times. R, U, R prime, U prime.
alg_right: Insert to the right. U, R, U prime, R prime, U prime, F prime, U, F.
alg_left: Insert to the left. U prime, L prime, U, L, U, F, U prime, F prime.
alg_fru: F, R, U, R prime, U prime, F prime.
alg_sune: R, U, R prime, U, R, U two, R prime.
alg_niklas: U, R, U prime, L prime, U, R prime, U prime, L.
alg_twist_2: R prime, D prime, R, D. Two times.
alg_twist_4: R prime, D prime, R, D. Four times.
m_B: Back face. Top row moves left.
m_Bp: Back face. Top row moves right.
m_y: Turn the whole cube, so the right side faces you.
m_yp: Turn the whole cube, so the left side faces you.
m_y2: Turn the whole cube around, back to front.
solved: Yes! You solved it! Amazing work.
already_solved: That cube is already solved! Scramble it up, and scan again.
selfie_pose: Strike a pose with your cube, and smile!
selfie_done: Looking great! Download your photo, and show it off.
learn_intro: Welcome to Learn! Start with the basics, then work your way up to the speed method. Every lesson has a 3D cube that plays the moves for you.
lesson_meet: Let's meet the cube. There are only three kinds of pieces: centres, edges and corners. The centres never move, so they tell you where everything belongs.
lesson_notation: Time to learn the language of cubing. Every face has a letter. A plain letter is a clockwise turn, prime means the other way, and two means a half turn. Tap the buttons and watch.
lesson_trigger: This is the trigger move. R, U, R prime, U prime. You'll use it everywhere, so let's get it into your fingers.
lesson_cross: Stage one is the white cross. We bring the four white edges down to the bottom, each one matching its side colour.
lesson_corners: Stage two. Park a white corner above its spot, then repeat the trigger move until it drops right in.
lesson_middle: Stage three is the middle layer. Line an edge up with its centre, then insert it to the right or to the left.
lesson_ycross: Stage four. One short algorithm turns the yellow top into a cross. Dot, then L, then line, then cross.
lesson_yedges: Stage five. We match the yellow edges with their side colours, using a move called Sune.
lesson_ycorners: Stage six. Corner homes. This algorithm cycles three corners until every one is home.
lesson_twist: The final stage! Twist each corner until yellow faces up. The bottom will look scrambled for a moment. Trust the process.
lesson_oll2: Two look OLL. Ten algorithms that turn the whole top yellow in just two steps.
lesson_pll2: Two look PLL. First the corners, then the edges. Six algorithms, and your last layer gets much faster.
lesson_f2l: F two L. Instead of solving layer by layer, pair each corner with its edge, and insert them together.
lesson_pllfull: Full PLL. Twenty one algorithms, one look, and the last layer is done.
lesson_faster: Want to go sub thirty? Plan your cross during inspection, turn smoothly without pauses, and use finger tricks.
tricks_intro: Tricks and patterns! Pick a pattern and follow along on your own cube. Then learn finger tricks, and the pro algorithms.
pattern_start: Start from a solved cube, with yellow on top and red in front. Follow along!
pattern_done: Ta da! Look at that pattern.
speed_intro: Welcome to Speed. Scramble your cube with the moves shown. Then hold the space bar, or press and hold the timer. Release to start, and tap to stop.
drill_intro: Algorithm drills. Look at the case, recall the algorithm, then check yourself. Cases you miss will come back more often.
w_u: Top two layers, to the left.
w_up: Top two layers, to the right.
w_d: Bottom two layers, to the right.
w_dp: Bottom two layers, to the left.
w_b: Back two layers. Top moves left.
w_bp: Back two layers. Top moves right.
m_x: Tip the whole cube up. The front goes to the top.
m_xp: Tip the whole cube down. The top comes to the front.
m_x2: Flip the whole cube upside down.
m_zp: Roll the whole cube counter clockwise.
m_z2: Roll the whole cube upside down.
goal_cross: First, we're building the white cross on the bottom.
goal_c_green_red_white: Next, the white, red and green corner. Let's bring it home.
goal_c_green_orange_white: Next, the white, green and orange corner. Let's bring it home.
goal_c_blue_orange_white: Next, the white, orange and blue corner. Let's bring it home.
goal_c_blue_red_white: Next, the white, blue and red corner. Let's bring it home.
goal_e_green_red: Now the red and green edge. We'll slot it into the middle layer.
goal_e_green_orange: Now the green and orange edge. We'll slot it into the middle layer.
goal_e_blue_orange: Now the orange and blue edge. We'll slot it into the middle layer.
goal_e_blue_red: Now the blue and red edge. We'll slot it into the middle layer.
goal_ycross: Now we're turning the top into a yellow cross.
goal_yedges: Now we're matching the yellow edges with their side colours.
goal_ycorners: Now we're moving the yellow corners to their homes.
goal_twist: Last part. We twist each corner until yellow faces up.
stuck_open: No worries. Let's get you back on track. Pick an option.
check_prompt: Hold any side of the cube up to the camera, inside the box, and keep it still.
check_ok: You're right on track! Carry on.
check_found: Found you! I'll move the guide to where your cube is.
check_lost: Hmm, that side doesn't match. Let's rescan the whole cube, and I'll plan a fresh route.
undo_start: Let's undo. Follow the reverse moves.
replan_done: New route ready. Let's keep going!
wrong_prompt: Tap the moves you actually did, and I'll plan a new route from there.
